  "content": "import sqlite3
import os
from datetime import datetime
from flask import g, current_app

DATABASE_NAME = "taskflow.db"


def get_db():
    """Return a request-scoped SQLite database connection with row factory and WAL mode."""
    if "db" not in g:
        db_path = current_app.config.get("DATABASE", os.path.join(current_app.instance_path, DATABASE_NAME))
        
        # Ensure instance directory exists if using instance path
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path)), exist_ok=True)
        
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, detect_types=sqlite3.PARSE_DECLTYPES | sqlite3.PARSE_COLNAMES)
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        
        # Enforce SQLite foreign keys and WAL mode for high concurrency
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;")
        
        g.db = conn
    return g.db


def close_db(e=None):
    """Close the database connection at the end of the request."""
    db = g.pop("db", None)
    if db is not None:
        db.close()


def init_db(app):
    """Initialize the SQLite schema with all required tables, constraints, and indexes."""
    with app.app_context():
        db = get_db()
        
        # Projects table
        db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            color TEXT DEFAULT '#3b82f6',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        """)
        
        # Tasks table
        db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            project_id INTEGER,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo',
            priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
            due_date TEXT,
            completed_at TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
        );
        """)
        
        # Tags table
        db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            color TEXT DEFAULT '#64748b'
        );
        """)
        
        # TaskTag association table
        db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_tags (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            tag_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(task_id, tag_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        );
        """)
        
        # Indexes as required by spec for fast filtering on Task(status, due_date, project_id)
        db.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_status ON tasks(status);")
        db.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_due_date ON tasks(due_date);")
        db.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_project_id ON tasks(project_id);")
        db.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_tags_task ON task_tags(task_id);")
        db.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_tags_tag ON task_tags(tag_id);")
        
        db.commit()


def init_app(app):
    """Register database management functions with the Flask app instance."""
    app.teardown_appcontext(close_db)
    init_db(app)
